title: Google Sheets from the MCP server
items: add_destination and update_destination take Google Sheets destinations: format sheets with the spreadsheet and its columns, so an agent sets one up from start to finish without the dashboard or the SDK
create_spreadsheet can write the header row into a spreadsheet chosen with pick_spreadsheet
Remote MCP clients connected to an address with tool settings, such as /mcp?tools=all, get metadata that names that address and a token request that accepts it
